## Manager.extend() method

Registers a driver of your own, or replaces one of the built-ins.

**Signature:**

```typescript
extend(name: string, factory: DriverFactory<TDriver, TContext>): this;
```

**Returns:**

this

This manager, for chaining.

## Remarks

Any instance already resolved under this name is discarded, so the next call builds from the new factory. It is not closed — whoever supplied the replacement owns the old one.

## Example


```ts
cache.extend('tiered', (context) => createTieredStore(context))
```
